delivered.statement: Q2 revenue ₹73,188 crore; 0.5% constant currency QoQ, 2.8% YoY growth.
Operating margin 24% (stable sequentially); net margin 19%; cash conversion 102.2% of NI.
Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion; crossed 10% of overall company revenue.
TCV $9.6 billion; order book healthy with broad-based growth across geographies and verticals.
International revenue +1.2% QoQ constant currency; UK led at 3.5%; all markets grew.
BFSI +2.5% QoQ; Manufacturing +3.1% QoQ; Technology & Services +3.1% QoQ constant currency.
Workforce 598,056 associates; IT services attrition LTM 13.3%; learning hours 17.1M (17% increase).
Funds invested $5.98 billion; DSO 74 days; strong cash conversion despite growth investments.

themes: Enterprise AI adoption scaling from isolated use cases to governed agentic systems globally.
AI revenue $3.1B (10%+ total) becoming pervasive across all transformations, no substitution.
Demand selective, uneven; discretionary programs under scrutiny; medium-term momentum confident on pipeline strength.
Vendor consolidation and AI-powered engineering creating tailwinds in traditional service portfolios.
Prioritizing strategic investments in capacity, partnerships, acquisitions despite near-term margin headwinds.
Agentic control planes, AI governance, cost controls, security emerging as critical enterprise needs.
risks: Regional markets volatile, lumpy; India project deferral impacted Q2 revenue sequentially.
North America growth (2.4% YoY) lagging company average; recovery timing uncertain.
Subcontracting costs surging 40% YoY; key margin lever to reach 26%+ aspiration.
AI productivity deflation in BFSI, Hi-Tech partially offsetting incremental opportunity growth gains.
analyst_pushback: AI substitution vs incremental: Ruchi asked if cannibalization. Aarthi: AI pervasive, complementary across transformations.
India decline: Ravi flagged 10% drop, client metrics. Krithi: Project deferral, no structural issue, recovery expected.
Margin recovery path: Multiple analysts questioned 25% exit. Samir: Prioritizing growth, will inch up gradually.
North America weakness: Dipesh noted half company growth. Krithi: TCV strong, conversations good, recovery soon.
tone_evidence: Confident on AI opportunity and medium-term growth; cautious on near-term selective demand; defensive on margin path.
